Sourdough pizza, three days in the making.

Keanu's is a neighbourhood pizzeria in a villa on Al Wasl Road. The dough ferments for three days, the oven burns wood, and dinner starts when you walk in.

See the pizzas Find the villa
KEANU WAS HERE

A villa, an oven, and a question.

Keanu's opened in mid October 2026, in the villa next door to Three by Eva, by the same team.

At the launch party, a projector asked the room one question: WHO IS KEANU? And the pizza boxes are yellow, printed with the words KEANU WAS HERE.

What is not a mystery is the food. This is a walk in neighbourhood spot, no bookings, no fuss. You come hungry, you watch the fire, you eat.

The dough rises.

Every pizza here starts three days before you order it. Keep scrolling and watch what patience does to a ball of dough.

  1. Day one, mixedFlour, water and starter come together. Small, dense, and in no hurry.
  2. Day two, waking upThe ferment gets to work. Bubbles form and the dough starts to breathe.
  3. Day three, readyLight, open and full of flavour. Now it can meet the wood fire.

The pizzas

Five signatures on the three day sourdough, all from the wood fired oven. Walk ins only, so the menu is short and the fire decides the pace.

WHO IS
KEANU?

Still a fair question.

It was the projection at the launch party, and it is still the best introduction to the place. What Keanu's does is plainer: dough fermented over three days, a wood fired oven, and dinner from five until midnight.

The yellow pizza boxes carry the other half of the story: KEANU WAS HERE.

Walk in tonight

No bookings, no reservations line. Keanu's is walk ins only, so just come to the villa.
